# v0.10.0 · 全新工作空间 / A New Workspace

## 中文

### 全新 UI 设计

新版工作空间围绕「资料输入 → 智能处理 → 成果交付」重新组织界面。首页呈现清晰的业务入口，流程页突出当前阶段、目录层级、生成进度和下一步操作，让长流程中的位置与状态一目了然。统一的深色视觉语言、卡片层级和细致的过渡动效，让售前、招投标、公文、课题和项目等场景保持一致的使用体验。

### 体验改进

- 首次进入新版 UI 时展示欢迎页；设置中仍可选择界面模式，并可开启「减少动态效果」以适配偏好或性能需求。
- 优化技术方案、已有方案扩写与可研报告的目录和正文流程，目录层级、生成过程与进度反馈更易阅读。
- 调整弹窗、设置导航、项目协作等页面的布局与交互，减少不必要的滚动和视觉干扰。
- 完善正文生成期间修改前置配置的提示，并修复相关流程状态与缓存问题。

## English

### A new UI, built around the work

The redesigned workspace follows a simple path: **input materials → intelligent processing → deliverable results**. The home page makes each workflow easy to find; workflow screens make the current step, outline hierarchy, generation progress, and next action easier to understand. A consistent dark visual system, clearer card hierarchy, and considered transitions bring the same experience across presales, bidding, document writing, research applications, and project work.

### Improvements

- Added a first-run welcome screen for the new UI. You can still choose the interface mode and enable Reduce Motion in Settings.
- Improved outlines, body generation screens, and progress feedback for technical plans, expansion of existing plans, and feasibility reports.
- Refined dialogs, Settings navigation, and project collaboration layouts to reduce unnecessary scrolling and visual clutter.
- Clarified what happens when upstream settings change during body generation and fixed related workflow state and cache issues.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liwg1995/YuduBid/compare/v0.9.23...v0.10.0
